personality_one_liner: A professional, highly legible, and reassuring internal workspace that feels native, snappy, and content-first.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. Use md/lg padding around content to frame it, avoiding dense dashboard-style crowding.

do's: Floating Action Button (FAB) for document upload

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A highly glanceable dashboard serving critical alerts (expiring certs), quick actions, and top company updates.

states.empty: No current updates or pending tasks.
states.error: Could not load dashboard data. [Retry Button]

screens.layout: Data-driven modular widgets. Top: 'Good Morning' header. Below header: Horizontal scrollable quick actions (Upload, Tasks). Next: Prominent warning card if a certificate is expiring < 30 days. Rest of page: Vertical feed of Company Updates & Events using card layouts.

screens.name: Chat
screens.purpose: A unified communication hub dividing team channels and direct messages.

states.empty: No messages yet. Start a conversation.

screens.layout: Top segmented control to switch between 'Channels' and 'Direct Messages'. List view with avatar/initials on left, title/name, preview text, and timestamp on right. Unread indicators use brandPrimary dots. Bottom fixed composer inside actual chat thread screens.

screens.name: Certificates
screens.purpose: A clear, status-driven repository for compliance documents and training certificates.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No certificates uploaded yet.' + Upload CTA

screens.layout: Vertical list or grid. Expiring/Expired items always surfaced at the top. Each card shows document title, small file icon, and a bold color-coded status badge (Green for Valid, Yellow for Expiring, Red for Expired). Persistent FAB (glassmorphism) in bottom right for uploading new files.

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: A structural directory for long-lived company resources (Policies, Procedures, Tasks list).
screens.layout: Clean, list-based iOS setting-style rows grouping 'Policies', 'Company Directory', 'All Tasks'. Use brandTertiary tinted icon containers for each row to add polish.

empty_state_abstract.alt: Abstract calming minimal background for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the iOS-Native Clean personality. Ensure generous padding and avoid dense dashboard elements.
Implement a Light Theme ONLY as requested by the user.
Never use blue, indigo, or purple. Stick to the Sage Green (brandPrimary #4F7959) for trust and productivity. Adhere to the zero-tolerance rule for banned colors.
For the 'Certificates' screen, surface items dynamically based on status (Expired/Expiring at the top). Use the explicit warning (#FF9F0A) and error (#FF3B30) tokens for badges.
Implement glassmorphism on the bottom tab bar and header navigation to maintain a premium native feel.
Ensure the 'Upload' FAB in the Certificates tab is persistent, floating, and utilizes a glass or branded background.
Make sure all tappable areas (especially chat list rows and library items) are at least 44x44pt.
Always apply Loading, Empty, and Error states natively to each screen, full-flexed.
